official.deadline_central_display: No application deadline - no application is required; scholarships are automatically assessed upon application for admission for 2027 or later commencement
official.application_cycle: 2027 commencement (applies to new international students who receive an offer and commence study in 2027 or later)
official.status_note: 'This version of the scholarship applies to new international students who receive an offer and commence study in 2027 or later.' No application is required; eligible students are notified of the value within the Letter of Offer.
official.tuition_coverage_note: 'The scholarship benefit is a variable value for each year of study under a standard full-time study load (80 units) apportioned over each course taken... administered for each term of study in the eligible program(s) as a tuition fee reduction.' Annual value: 'a dollar value equivalent to 20% of the gross annual international tuition fee'; unit value (based on 10 units): 'equivalent to 20% of the gross unit value variable based on program of study'. 'You will be billed normal tuition fee rates... The tuition fee waiver may not be reflected on the tuition fee account until census has passed.'
benefits: Annual value: a dollar value equivalent to 20% of the gross annual international tuition fee
Unit value (based on 10 units): a dollar value equivalent to 20% of the gross unit value, variable by program of study
Applied each term as a tuition fee reduction after Census date, on a pro-rata basis for reduced loads, credit exemptions, recognition of prior learning, progression or partial-year enrolments
Indicative number available: 500 (varied depending on eligible candidates)
eligibility: Be an international full fee-paying student
Be commencing study in an eligible CRICOS-registered undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree program at the University
Not be the beneficiary of a separate University scholarship unless prior approval for special dispensation has been obtained
Be able to meet the financial obligations of a full fee-paying international student specified by the Australian Government (evidence provided if requested)
Not be enrolled in a program of study covered under a quota arrangement limiting international enrolments
Reside within 50 km of the campus location specified on your Confirmation of Enrolment (COE)
requirements: Required documents: 'None Required.' (stated on the scholarship page)
Remain an international student enrolled in an eligible program and maintain the conditions of the scholarship for the waiver to apply each term
Reside within 50 km of the campus specified on the Confirmation of Enrolment
documents: None Required (the scholarship page states required documents: None Required; the application portal accepts PDF only, max 3 PDFs under 5 MB per field)
selection_criteria: No application is required - scholarships are automatically assessed upon application for admission to the University
Offers are made based on eligibility, aligned to the University's published entry and eligibility requirements, at the absolute discretion of the University
'Some students may not be eligible for an offer, even if criteria are met'
coverage: 20% of the gross annual international tuition fee, applied as a tuition fee reduction each term after Census date (pro-rata)
Living costs, accommodation and travel are not covered
application_method: No application is required for this scholarship
Scholarships are automatically assessed upon application for admission to the University
Eligible students receive notification of the value of the scholarship within the Letter of Offer
If you wish to reject an offer of scholarship, it is your responsibility to inform the University
official.application_route: Nothing to apply for - the scholarship is assessed automatically when you apply for admission; the value appears in your Letter of Offer.
official.study_mode: Full-time standard load referenced (80 units per year); benefit apportioned per course with pro-rata for approved reduced loads
official.citizenship_residency: Must be an international (full fee-paying) student; must reside within 50 km of the campus specified on the Confirmation of Enrolment.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scholarship is exclusively for international students.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Eligible CRICOS-registered undergraduate or postgraduate coursework programs only; excluded are English Language Bridging Program, Enabling, Non-Award, Exchange or Study Abroad, Higher Degrees by Research, degrees without a CRICOS code, standalone Graduate Certificate or Graduate Diploma programs, offshore or online delivery, internal transfers at an Australian campus, externally sponsored students, Australia Awards recipients, and transfers from the University's Singapore campus.
official.duration: Ongoing for each term of the eligible program, provided the conditions of the scholarship are maintained
official.description: The University of Newcastle's International Excellence Scholarship 2027 has been established to attract high-performing students to study at the University, acknowledging applicants with a strong academic background and providing an ongoing incentive for continued academic achievement, through an automatic 20% reduction of the gross annual international tuition fee for eligible coursework students commencing in 2027 or later.
official.program_type: University merit scholarship (automatic tuition fee reduction)

verification.notes: Read the official scholarship page for UNI_053 (establishment, eligibility, 'None Required' documents, benefit wording, 20% annual/unit values, automatic assessment, 500 indicative number, exclusion list, contact details) and located the 2027 Terms and Conditions PDF published on the University's own domain.

applicant_utility.summary: There is nothing to apply for here: the University assesses this scholarship automatically when you apply for admission, and the value shows up in your Letter of Offer, so your only real task is making sure your programme and circumstances stay inside the eligibility rules. The discount is 20% of the gross annual international tuition fee applied term by term after Census date - not a cash payment - and the page warns that the waiver may not appear on your tuition account until after census, so keep paying the expected amount minus the scholarship by each due date rather than waiting to see it. Because it is awarded on eligibility at the University's discretion, meeting every criterion still does not guarantee an offer, and the indicative 500 places vary with the eligible cohort.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International students starting an eligible CRICOS-registered coursework degree at Newcastle in 2027 or later who live within 50 km of campus and hold no other University scholarship.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your target programme is a CRICOS-registered undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree (not HDR, enabling, exchange, study abroad, standalone graduate certificate/diploma, or online/offshore)
Secure accommodation within 50 km of the campus named on your Confirmation of Enrolment before the CoE is issued
Check you are not holding another University scholarship or external sponsorship, which would disqualify the automatic offer
Meet the Australian Government's financial-obligation requirements for full fee-paying international students and keep evidence ready if requested
common_rejection_risks: Enrolling in a quota-limited programme, which removes eligibility
Being sponsored by an external entity or holding an Australia Award, both excluded
Transferring internally at an Australian campus or from the Singapore campus - excluded from this version
Holding a separate University scholarship without prior special dispensation
Assuming automatic assessment guarantees an award - the University reserves the right not to award
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Everything except the 20% tuition reduction: the remaining 80% of tuition, accommodation, living costs, overseas student health cover and flights are all self-funded.
document_audit: No documents are required for the scholarship itself; the admission application carries the evidence
Your residential address matters - it must sit within 50 km of the campus on the CoE
alerts: Do not delay tuition payment waiting for the waiver - the benefit is applied after Census date and you are asked to pay tuition minus the expected scholarship by the due date
The 2027 Terms and Conditions govern this intake; students holding 2026-or-earlier offers fall under earlier versions
The waiver continues only while you remain international, enrolled in an eligible program and meeting the scholarship conditions
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply for admission; the University assesses eligibility automatically, then notifies the scholarship value in the Letter of Offer; rejection of the offer is the student's responsibility to communicate.
